subject: 17 tools your agents can call
body:
The MCP server exposes seventeen read first tools: search newsletters, articles, entities and sponsors, then fetch a publication, its articles, its intelligence summary, or an entity page with its mention history. One tool creates an export, and typed ids keep references stable across calls.

An agent carries a publication from search into a profile without a mapping table, which is the part an action library cares about.

Docs are at [DOCS_LINK], endpoint [MCP_LINK]. A trial key settles it faster than a call.
